name: Magna-gun
description: The magna-gun was a powerful brand of ion cannon on the planet Brentaal IV. During his campaign for power in 21 BBY, Separatist warlord Shogar Tok took control of the magna-guns and established them at his fortress on the world. They were sabotaged by Jedi Master Quinlan Vos during the Battle of Brentaal IV of the Clone Wars.
